patch_description:
The current circuit has 174 parameters, which is significantly over-parameterized compared to the prior 114-parameter version that achieved nearly the same score (0.60 vs 0.61). The recommendation suggests tying symmetric two-qubit rotation parameters in the mixed entanglement layer.

Specifically:
1. Merge crz_0 & crz_3 into "crz_s1" (both control-target pairs on non-adjacent qubits)
2. Merge crz_2 & crz_6 into "crz_s2" (similar symmetric pattern)
3. Merge cry_1 & cry_5 into "cry_s" (symmetric CRY gates)

Additionally, the output layer has 9 individual RY parameters that can be shared in an alternating pattern (similar to the input layer's proven ry_0/ry_1 pattern), reducing from 9 to 2 parameters.

This reduces the parameter count from 174 to approximately 156, improving parameter efficiency while preserving the circuit's expressivity through the proven entanglement structure. The symmetric sharing follows the success of global RZ sharing and respects the nonadjacent connectivity constraints.
